lines.en: I crawl faster than my kin, and steadier.
I work my way up a stone ridge.

lines.zh: 我的身子更粗，压出深沟。
lines.en: My body is thicker, cutting a deeper groove.

lines.zh: 我抽出晶刺，扎进土里往前。
lines.en: I plant crystal spikes and haul forward.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪向那块原石。
lines.en: I inch toward that originium.

lines.zh: 我绕过一堆碎石，没有停。
lines.en: I go around a rubble heap without stopping.
I raise my front half to see the way.
I head toward the iron.
I drag myself, pushing the sand aside.

lines.zh: 我转身时，整条身子跟着转。
lines.en: When I turn, my whole length turns.

lines.zh: 我从石下钻出来，带着土。
lines.en: I come out from under the stone, dirt and all.
I crawl slowly your way.
I have more segments than the others.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方温度高一点。
lines.en: The ground runs warmer where I crawl.

lines.zh: 我沿着裂缝走，那里好走。
lines.en: I follow the crack; it's easier there.

lines.zh: 我一节一节收紧，再松开。
lines.en: I tighten segment by segment, then release.
I coil, my crystal spikes upright.
I'm sniffing; the smell here is mixed.
My body is harder than my kin's.

lines.zh: 我数着自己身上的节，很慢。
lines.en: I count the segments along my body, slowly.
I rest my head on a stone.

lines.zh: 我的晶刺贴着土，探着震。
lines.en: My crystal spines touch the soil, feeling for tremors.
I'm hungry, but not hurried.
I remember being fed iron.
I shudder, and dirt falls off.
I lift my head slowly and look far off.

lines.zh: 我把前半身抬起来，听了听。
lines.en: I raise my front half and listen.
I press my body to the ground.
You're carrying iron; I can tell.
I raise my head, higher than my kin.
I want what's in your hand.
You're more timid than I expected.
I cock my head and size you up.
You back off, and I slow.
My crystal spikes shine in the light.
Are you far enough?
I remember your hands.
I rear up toward you.
One of my spikes broke.
I coil once, then uncoil.
I shrink into the crack's shade.

lines.zh: 我扭了一下，把碎晶抖落。
lines.en: I twist and shake the broken crystals off.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，土和碎晶落下。
lines.en: I shudder, and dirt and chips fall.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我只是抽了一下。
lines.en: I don't cry out; I only jerk.
I press to the ground and recover.

lines.zh: 我吐了点丝，把伤口围住。
lines.en: I spin silk around the wound.

lines.zh: 我的头有点歪，慢慢正回来。
lines.en: My head is askew; I slowly right it.
I can still crawl, not much slower.
Iron; I smell it.
That iron in your hand — mine.
I rear up to reach higher.

lines.zh: 那味道比同类说的还香。
lines.en: That smells better than my kin said.
I creep toward your palm.
Set it down; I won't snatch.
Hold it high, and I can't reach.
I need it; growing crystal costs.
The rust smell makes me hurry.
One more piece and I'll go.
You hit me like a stone post.
I give a little, pushing the soil.
My spikes scrape your armor.
I go around instead of ramming.
You step on me, and I jerk.
I butt your leg, heavy.
We collide, and the sand churns.
I lie flat and wait for you to move.
I loop around your boot.
You back off; only then do I loosen.
Another is slimmer than I am.
Her spikes are shorter but denser.
We wind our bodies together.
She eats iron slowly; I wait.
We coil on the warm stone together.
She nuzzles my head, hard.
We bury our bodies in the sand.
I know her scent.
We crawl toward the originium together.
Two worms, one deep groove.
I take up a whole iron ingot.
I drag off your hammer.
I pick up originium and swallow it.
I carry off your fallen arrow.

lines.zh: 我卷起一块布，缠在身上。
lines.en: I curl a cloth around myself.

lines.zh: 我把石头推开，找出底下的铁。
lines.en: I push the stone away to find the iron.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的盾边，拖了两步。
lines.en: I bite your shield's rim and drag it two paces.
I hook a spike into the cloth sack.
I pick up bone shards and press them under me.
I knock that water bottle over.
I smell the iron on it.
I raise my head; I'm locked on.
I'm faster than my kin; you know it.
It broke my stone.
I start crawling, and won't stop.
I know this distance well.
My spikes have all risen.
It's at the end of this groove.
I chose this side to cut it off.
I'm faster than it thinks.
I rear up, taller than it.
I've walked this patch for years.
I follow low and fast.
It turns; I turn after.

lines.zh: 我把整条身子贴住沙面。
lines.en: I lay my whole length flat on the sand.
My spikes scrape stone, ringing.
It's climbing stone; it's slowed.
I loop around ahead of it.
It looks back; I freeze.
I push the sand aside, quietly.
It's panting; I'm not.

lines.zh: 我在等它踏上这块石头。
lines.en: I wait for it to step on this stone.
Three paces from it; enough.
I coil slowly, storing force.
I lash out and bite its leg.
My spikes sink into its armor's seam.

lines.zh: 我整个身子抽在它身上。
lines.en: My whole body lashes across it.
I coil around it and squeeze.
I butt the back of its knee.
I drag its leg into the sand.
That was twice my kin's weight.
It breaks loose; I change angle.
I lunge back in and bite again.
It stomps me; I don't let go.
A crystal spike comes out of the crack first.

lines.zh: 我从土里出来，比别的虫都粗。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil thicker than the others.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，带着湿气。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil, still damp.

lines.zh: 这块地底下埋着铁，我闻到了。
lines.en: There's iron buried under this ground. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我把自己从土里一寸寸抽出来。
lines.en: I draw myself out of the soil inch by inch.
The moment I emerge, the sand sinks.
I raise my head to see who's here.

lines.zh: 我从硬土里拱出来，晶还湿着。
lines.en: I push up out of the hard soil, crystals still wet.
This is a good place to coil.

lines.zh: 有东西在土面上走，我醒了。
lines.en: Something is walking on the soil. I'm awake.

lines.zh: 火烤得我的晶发红，我钻土。
lines.en: The heat reddens my crystal; I burrow.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，身子弹了一下。
lines.en: I fall, and my body bounces once.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软了，使不上劲。
lines.en: Water soaks me soft; I lose my strength.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀出去，压平了一片草。
lines.en: The blast throws me and flattens the grass.
An arrow lodges in one of my segments.
A spell winds around my body.

lines.zh: 没有铁，我的晶就长得慢。
lines.en: Without iron my crystal grows slowly.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，晶刺都炸了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me, and my spikes crackle.

lines.zh: 这里没有土，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There's no soil here; I keep falling.
